name: Drift
why: Scenes 11 to 13 as a song, every sound analog: the Warm kit's hands and the soft mallet's blip in seven open it; the kick waits, then comes in on one and three; your tresillo bass starts on its root and gains its twenty-note line; the stabs in fives come in dark and open up; a breakdown climbs suspended chords without landing, and the drop brings back your scene whole, with the kick that skips every third bar.

sections.name: Drift: Mist
sections.why: The hands, thinned, and your blip in seven on the soft mallet, drifting against the bar.

sections.name: Drift: Drift
sections.why: A few closed hats; your hand groove; the drops come in, thinned, on the plucked pulse.

sections.name: Drift: Footfall
sections.why: The kick on one and three; the drummer's hats; the bass on your tresillo, the root alone for now.

sections.name: Drift: The drift
sections.why: Your scene: the kick skipping every third bar, the 16th hats, the tresillo with its whole line, the stabs in fives coming in dark and opening a little.

sections.name: Drift: Lift
sections.why: The breakdown: no kick, no bass; sus2 chords stepping up from C without landing, the stabs opening bar by bar, the drops answered, the hats rising into the drop.

sections.name: Drift: Open water
sections.why: The drop: four on the floor, the stabs open and pumping on the kick, the blip developed, the drops back, the hands answering with a fill.

sections.name: Drift: Ebb
sections.why: On D, suspended: the kick thins, the bass back to its root, the stabs closing, the blip as it began.

name: Broken light
why: Scenes 14 to 16 in the order you made them, every sound analog: the gated chord on the warm pad (its filter moving all the way through), your broken four on the Warm kick, the bamboo answer on the ring bell and the blip in seven on the soft mallet. Scene 15 becomes the breakdown, no kick and the bass rolling in threes on F minor; Scene 16's open fifths are the drop.

sections.name: Broken light: Glint
sections.why: The hands, the blip in seven, and the gated chord far off, dark.

sections.name: Broken light: Shards
sections.why: Off-beat hats with a fill into the change; the bamboo answer on the ring bell; the chord a little brighter.

sections.name: Broken light: Broken four
sections.why: Scene 14: your broken four, the open off-beats with ticks between, the long bass on the and.

sections.name: Broken light: Undertow
sections.why: Scene 15: no kick and no hats, on F minor add 9; the bass rolling in threes, on its root at first.

sections.name: Broken light: Rise
sections.why: The bass gains its fifth; the chord opening bar by bar; the hats rising into the drop.

sections.name: Broken light: Open fifths
sections.why: Scene 16, the drop: open fifths to fourths on A, four on the floor, the off-beat hats played loose, the gated chord open and pumping on the kick, everything back.

sections.name: Broken light: Afterglow
sections.why: The kick thins, the long bass on the and, the chord closing, the blip in seven to end.

name: Seven
why: Snap 8, which you really liked, as a song on the 808 kit and the analog synth: your seven-step bass drifting against the four, starting on its root and growing into the whole line, developed when the harmony turns to D minor; the stab on the and as pulse brass, its filter opening into a kickless hollow; the bird calls on the ring bell and the marimba's answer on the soft mallet.

sections.name: Seven: Seed
sections.why: The hands, thinned, and the answer on the soft mallet.

sections.name: Seven: Seven
sections.why: A few hats; your hand groove; the bass on its seven steps, the root alone, drifting against the bar.

sections.name: Seven: Walk
sections.why: The kick; the drummer's hats; the bass's whole line; the bird calls on the ring bell.

sections.name: Seven: The bass walks on
sections.why: On D minor: the line developed (as it was, its tail moved, again, answered), your 16th hats, logs between the hands, the stab on the and coming in.

sections.name: Seven: Hollow
sections.why: No kick, no bass: the stab opening bar by bar, a bird or two, the hats rising into the drop.

sections.name: Seven: Full circle
sections.why: The drop, home on the A pedal: everything together, the stab open and pumping on the kick, the hats played loose.

sections.name: Seven: Seed again
sections.why: The kick thins to one and three, the bass long on the and, the answer as it began.
